scope: All previous OISST and 2026 AMSR2 outcomes have been viewed; new 2023-2025 AMSR2 acquisition is underway. iQuam SST targets have not been read; only one monthly variable/attribute inventory and official directory names have been inspected. Quality control uses Reynolds and CMC SST references and in situ data may overlap OISST inputs; this is a third measurement pathway, not statistically independent held-out truth or mechanism identification. Known observation times, depths and grid representation differ. Source versions are fixed to highest file-version suffix in the official directory before SST acquisition; no outcome-driven source selection.
